name: Community pantry
summary: Two afternoons a week the hall turns into a grocery store where everything is free. Fresh produce from three farms, bread from Marlow's, and staples you pick yourself off the shelf.

name: Thursday supper
summary: A hot meal at long tables, cooked by volunteers and eaten together. Kids eat first, seconds are expected, and whoever's left helps stack the chairs.

name: Rent & utility bridge
summary: One-time help paid straight to a landlord or utility, so a bad month doesn't become an eviction. Decided within a week, by people who live here.

name: Warm winter
summary: Coats, boots, space heaters and emergency heating oil from November to March — and a volunteer who'll carry the heater up the stairs.
